annotations.content:
Controls the startup splash sequence.

Responsibilities:
   - Determines splash display order.
   - Determines how long each splash remains visible.
   - Determines whether each splash can be skipped.
   - Requests splash presentation through SplashView.
   - Transitions the game to the Main Menu when complete.

 This controller does not directly manipulate UI elements.
 All visual presentation is delegated to SplashView.
